title: UC Berkeley Financial Aid Disbursement and Enrollment Adjustment Procedure

steps.label: Review Term Aid Application
steps.description_plain: Aid applies toward oldest charges in current/prior term of academic year.
steps.source_sentence: When you receive aid, all of your accepted financial aid for a current term will apply toward charges on your account before refunds are issued.

steps.label: Apply Aid to Oldest Charges
steps.description_plain: Aid prioritizes oldest account charges before current charges.
steps.source_sentence: Financial Aid applies to the oldest charges on the account before applying toward current charges.

steps.label: Assess Reduced Course Load Status
steps.description_plain: Awards assume 12 units at semester start; grants adjust if taking reduced load.
steps.source_sentence: At the start of the semester, Cal Grants and Pell Grants are awarded assuming you are enrolled in at least 12 units, but they pay differently.

steps.label: Census Enrollment Level Check
steps.description_plain: Enrollment captured at end of 5th week of classes to recalculate grant awards.

deadline.text: end of the 5th week of classes

steps.source_sentence: We capture your enrollment level at the end of the 5th week of classes and adjust Cal Grants and Pell Grants accordingly.

steps.label: Adjust Cal Grant Allocation
steps.description_plain: Cal Grant award offer reduced to match verified enrollment level.
steps.source_sentence: The amount of your Cal Grant award offer will be reduced to match your enrollment.

steps.label: Reconcile Pell Grant Invoice
steps.description_plain: Pell Grant reduction may generate an invoice on student bill.
steps.source_sentence: The amount of your Pell Grant award offer will be reduced to match your enrollment.

steps.label: Contact Cal Student Central
steps.description_plain: Consult advisor to review individual award adjustments.
steps.source_sentence: Contact Cal Student Central to find out how your individual awards may change.

gaps.description: Procedure if student cannot afford the repayment invoice generated by census reduction
